annotations.exact_quote: we propose two novel label enhancement methods, i.e., Label Enhancement with Sample Correlations (LESC) and generalized Label Enhancement with Sample Correlations (gLESC).
annotations.reason_zh: 摘要明确提出两种标签增强方法，任务是从逻辑标签恢复更细致的标签分布。

annotations.exact_quote: LESC employs a low-rank representation of samples in the feature space, and gLESC leverages a tensor multi-rank minimization to further investigate the sample correlations in both the feature space and label space.
annotations.reason_zh: 方法显式采用低秩表示与张量多秩最小化来利用样本相关结构。

annotations.exact_quote: Since most existing machine learning datasets merely provide logical labels, label distributions are unavailable in many real-world applications.
annotations.reason_zh: 以粗粒度逻辑标签替代完整标签分布作为监督条件，并围绕该监督不足问题提出标签增强方法。
